title: The Great Stone Face
author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
description: 《大石壁》是美国 19 世纪伟大作家纳撒尼尔·霍桑创作的杰出哲理名篇。故事讲述了生活在山谷里的男孩欧内斯特从小听母亲讲起一个古老传说：将来山谷里会出生一位伟人，其容貌将与对面高山上神圣庄严的大石壁一模一样，且必将成为时代最伟大的智者。欧内斯特一生都在静静期盼这位伟人的到来。他先后见到了富豪“老金钱袋”、战功赫赫的“血火将军”、雄辩演说家“老石角”以及伟大的诗人，但发现他们都缺乏大石壁那般高尚仁慈的灵魂。经过一生的沉思与善行，垂垂老矣的欧内斯特在讲道时，人们惊奇地发现，欧内斯特自己就是那位大石壁预言的伟人。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Mountain and the Ancient Prophecy
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：高山宏伟形象与古老神圣预言

paragraphs.en: One afternoon, when the sun was going down, a mother and her little boy sat at the door of their cottage, talking about the Great Stone Face. They had but to lift their eyes, and there it was plainly to be seen, though miles away, with the sunshine gilding all its noble features. The Great Stone Face was a work of Nature in her mood of majestic playfulness, formed on the perpendicular side of a mountain by immense rocks, which had been thrown together in such a position as to resemble the features of a giant human face.
paragraphs.zh: 一天下午，当太阳落山时，一位母亲和她的小男孩坐在农舍门口，谈论着大石壁。他们只需抬头，便能清晰地看到它，虽然远在数英里之外，阳光为它所有高尚的面貌镀上了金辉。大石壁是大自然在雄伟戏谑心境下的杰作，由巨大的岩石形成于高山的垂直侧面，这些岩石被抛在这样的位置，正好酷似一张巨型人类面庞的面貌。

paragraphs.en: There was the broad front, with its sunlit brow; the nose, with its long, noble bridge; and the vast lips, which, if they could have spoken, would have uttered a grand voice, echoing through the valley. It was a happy lot for children to grow up in the shadow of that mountain, for all its features were divine and benevolent, inspiring every watcher with thoughts of purity, majesty, and love.
paragraphs.zh: 那里有宽阔的额头，带着被阳光照耀的眉宇；有鼻子，带着漫长高尚的鼻梁；还有巨大的双唇，如果它们能说话，一定会发出宏伟的声音，在山谷中回荡。对于孩子们来说，在那座山峰的影子下长大是一种幸福的命运，因为它的所有面貌都是神圣而仁慈的，赋予每个观看者纯洁、雄伟与爱的思想。

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Ernest’s Childhood and Faith
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：欧内斯特的童年与虔诚期盼

paragraphs.en: The little boy's name was Ernest. 'Mother,' said he, as he sat looking up at the majestic profile, 'I wish that it could speak, for it looks so very kindly that its voice must needs be pleasant. If I were to see a man with such a face, I should love him dearly!' 'If an old prophecy should come to pass,' answered his mother, 'we may see such a man some day, with exactly the likeness of the Great Stone Face.'
paragraphs.zh: 小男孩的名字叫欧内斯特。“母亲，”当他坐着仰望那雄伟的侧影时说，“我希望它能说话，因为它看起来是如此和蔼，它的声音一定很悦耳。如果我能见到一个长着这样一张脸的人，我一定会深深地爱他！”“如果一个古老预言能实现的话，”他的母亲回答道，“有一天我们可能会见到这样一个长得与大石壁一模一样的人。”

paragraphs.en: She then recounted the ancient prophecy: that a child should be born in this valley destined to become the greatest and noblest personage of his time, whose countenance in manhood should bear an exact resemblance to the Great Stone Face. Ernest listened with reverent wonder, and the prophecy sank deep into his soul.
paragraphs.zh: 接着她讲述了古老预言：将来会有一个孩子出生在这个山谷里，注定要成为他那个时代最伟大、最高尚的人物，而他在成年时的面貌，将与大石壁产生精确的相似。欧内斯特带着虔诚的奇迹倾听着，预言深深沉入了她的灵魂。

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Mr. Gathergold’s Return and Demise
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：巨富“老金钱袋”的荣耀与破灭

paragraphs.en: Years passed, and Ernest grew into a young man. Meanwhile, news spread through the valley that a native named Gathergold, who had ammassed immense wealth in distant cities, was returning to build a marble palace. Rumors swirled that Mr. Gathergold's face bore the exact resemblance to the Great Stone Face.
paragraphs.zh: 几年过去了，欧内斯特长成了一个年轻人。与此同时，消息在山谷里流传开来：一位名叫“金钱袋”的山谷居民（在遥远的城市里积聚了巨大的财富）正在归来建造一座大理石城堡。谣言在流传，金钱袋先生的面貌与大石壁有着精确的相似。

paragraphs.en: Ernest looked into Mr. Gathergold's carriage window and saw an old man with yellow, wrinkled skin and greedy eyes. It was the face of cold, selfish avarice. Ernest turned away in deep disappointment. Years later, Mr. Gathergold died in poverty after losing his fortune, and the valley realized his face had never borne any true resemblance.
paragraphs.zh: 欧内斯特看向金钱袋先生的马车窗户，看到了一位皮肤发黄褶皱、有着贪婪双眼的老人。那是一张冰冷自私贪婪的面孔。欧内斯特带着深深的失望转过身去。几年后，金钱袋先生在失去财产后在贫困中死去，山谷里的人们意识到他的脸从未产生过任何真正的相似。

chapters.title: Chapter 4: General Blood-and-Thunder’s Arrival
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：“血火将军”的赫赫战功与冷酷

paragraphs.en: More years rolled on, and another native of the valley achieved fame—a brave soldier known as 'General Blood-and-Thunder.' He had won glorious battle victories, and the valley inhabitants claimed his face was the very image of the Great Stone Face.
paragraphs.zh: 更多的年份滚动而过，另一位山谷居民赢得了声誉——一位被称为“血火将军”的勇敢士兵。他赢得了辉煌的战斗胜利，山谷里的居民声称他的面貌正是大石壁的形象。

paragraphs.en: Ernest observed the General at a grand banquet. There was majesty in his iron brow, but Ernest looked in vain for the tender compassion and divine love that radiated from the mountain visage. The General's face was forged in iron and war, devoid of spiritual grace.
paragraphs.zh: 欧内斯特在盛大的宴会上观察着将军。在他铁石般的眉宇中有雄伟，但欧内斯特徒劳地寻找着从高山面貌中散发出的温柔同情与神圣之爱。将军的面庞是由铁石与战争铸就的，缺乏精神上的恩典。

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Old Stony Phiz and the Political Orator
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：“老石角”政治家与虚无演讲

paragraphs.en: A third candidate emerged—a famous politician known as 'Old Stony Phiz,' whose silver tongue could persuade crowds. When he visited the valley, crowds proclaimed him the likeness of the mountain. But when Ernest listened to his grand speeches, he felt that the orator lacked true conviction; his words were magnificent shells containing no inner soul.
paragraphs.zh: 第三位候选人出现了——一位被称为“老石角”的著名政治家，他的银舌头可以劝说人群。当他拜访山谷时，人群指认他为高山的形象。但当欧内斯特倾听他宏伟的演讲时，他感觉这位演说家缺乏真正的信念；他的话语是包含没有内在灵魂的宏伟外壳。

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Great Poet’s Visit
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 6 章：浪漫伟大的诗人拜访

paragraphs.en: Then arrived a famous Poet, whose sublime verses celebrated the beauty of nature and the human soul. Ernest read the Poet's works with delight, believing that here at last was a mind worthy of the Great Stone Face. The Poet visited Ernest's humble cottage, and the two men conversed deeply under the sky.
paragraphs.zh: 接着一位著名的诗人到达了，他崇高的诗句歌颂着自然的美丽与人类灵魂。欧内斯特带着喜悦阅读着诗人的作品，相信这里终于出现了一个配得上大石壁的头脑。诗人拜访了欧内斯特谦逊的农舍，两人在天空下进行了深刻的交谈。

paragraphs.en: Yet as they talked, the Poet humbly confessed: 'No, Ernest, I am not the fulfillment of the prophecy. My thoughts are beautiful, but my life has not been lived in harmony with my poetry.' Ernest wept softly, saddened that the noble image had not yet taken human form.
paragraphs.zh: 然而当他们交谈时，诗人谦逊地承认：“不，欧内斯特，我不是预言的实现。我的思想是美丽的，但我的生命并没有与我的诗歌生活在和谐中。”欧内斯特软软地哭了，为那高尚的形象尚未采取人类形式感到悲伤。

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Sunset Discourse at the Rocks
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 7 章：岩石间天然露天剧场的夕阳讲道

paragraphs.en: At sunset, according to his custom, Ernest went to speak to the gathered inhabitants in a natural amphitheatre among the rocks. The Poet accompanied him, standing quietly in the audience to observe the old man. Ernest stood upon a high boulder, his white hair flowing around his shoulders like a halo, his face glowing with divine light and boundless love.
paragraphs.zh: 日落时分，按照他的习惯，欧内斯特来到岩石间的一个天然露天剧场，向聚集的居民发表讲话。诗人陪同着他，安静地站在听众中观察这位老人。欧内斯特站在一块高大的巨石上，他的白发像光环一样流淌在肩膀周围，他的面庞闪烁着神圣的光芒与无尽的爱。

paragraphs.en: When Ernest spoke, his words were living truths born of a lifetime of noble deeds, pure thoughts, and humble devotion. His heart spoke directly to the hearts of his listeners, inspiring everyone with reverent awe and peaceful joy.
paragraphs.zh: 当欧内斯特说话时，他的话语是诞生于一生高尚善行、纯洁思想与谦逊奉献的活生生真理。他的心直接向听众的心说话，用虔诚的敬畏与和平的喜悦鼓舞着每个人。

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Fulfillment of the Prophecy
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 8 章：预言的终极实现与圣者显现（终极结局）

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, as the golden rays of the setting sun illuminated the Great Stone Face on the mountain cliff, the Poet looked from the mountain to Ernest and shouted aloud: 'Behold! Behold! Ernest himself is the exact likeness of the Great Stone Face!'
paragraphs.zh: 突然，当落日的金色光芒照亮山悬崖上的大石壁时，诗人从山峰看向欧内斯特，大声喊道：“看啊！看啊！欧内斯特自己就是大石壁精确的形象！”

paragraphs.en: The entire assembly looked, and saw that it was indeed true. The broad brow, the gentle eyes, and the benevolent smile of Ernest matched the majestic cliff in every detail! The prophecy was fulfilled at last. Yet Ernest took the Poet's arm and walked slowly home, still hoping that some wiser and better man than himself would one day appear.
paragraphs.zh: 整个集会看去，看到那确实是真的。宽阔的额头、温柔的双眼以及欧内斯特仁慈的微笑在每一个细节上都与雄伟的悬崖相匹配！预言终于实现了。然而欧内斯特挽着诗人的手臂慢慢走回家，依然希望有一天会出现一个比他自己更明智、更好的人。
